task_summary: Backtested the SMMA-stack "big fat candle" trend-pullback system on EURUSD H1 (10yr) and GBPUSD H1 (21yr); REJECTED — faithful spec fires ≤3 times/decade (no tradeable sample), and every loosening that yields a real sample is net-negative after cost (PF 0.6–0.8).
